walkthrough: Goal: V大's 结构翻转 (weeks 5 and 6): an object seen as a few solids in a box well enough to draw it from an angle I have not seen; the box first, then each part by halves and thirds, then the visible edges. The app lays the exact answer over my drawing and my eye judges it (the author, 2026-11-16).

Entry: unit 5's tile Structure rotation (after key shifts and abstract analysis), or Start when it is next; no pack is needed. A lesson holds one object, about 6 minutes. Level 1 turns it a quarter about its upright, the eye's height kept, one change (a block or a cut); level 2 sees it from another height (from above where the picture is across or from below, or the reverse), a quarter or a half turned, a cut or a top drawn in; level 3 a round part standing on its base, from another height and turned, only the new box's near upright printed beside a small box at the new angle.

How, first time: An object from a new angle; an object seen as a few solids in a box, drawn from an angle you have not seen. The example plays beside its picture (a box with a slope cut, its own seed): 1 the box tight round the object in the picture, drawn through in pencil; 2 the same box at the new angle completed from its front corner, three edges and horizon; 3 the cut's points found by halves and thirds; 4 the visible edges in ink, the first a little off; 5 Compare: the visible edges red, the hidden ones dashed red. One paragraph says to find each part's place in the picture's box, the same points in the new box, the big shapes first, the small box's edges run on where only the upright is given. Got it.

The exercise: the left frame holds the object lit on paper (an L-shaped block, its step at the front left, seen across the horizon); my frame holds the horizon (labelled) and the new box's front corner with its three edges, printed grey: the same block turned a quarter. The tools: Sketch, Draw, Undo, Redo; Compare once something is drawn.

With Sketch I complete the box (its nine other edges, the far ones through); with Draw the visible edges: the tall part at the back left, the step at the front right, but I put the step a little too high (a mistake).

Compare: the turned object's visible edges in see-through red over my ink, the edges it hides dashed red; my step's lines stand above the red. The card: Structure rotation 1, Construction, How close is it?, Accurate, Almost, Again; no reason, nothing ringed, no number. The pen is blue (Correct). Construction lays the new box in pencil (its hidden edges dashed) and V大's construction in dashed pencil in my frame, the corners it finds ringed; tapped again, it goes.

I redraw the step on the red in blue and Compare again; I choose Almost, kept with the exercise once. Finish: the lesson's end, Structure rotation, 1 exercise, its result. One more: the next object (a box with a corner cut, turned the other quarter) on the next row of the same sheet.
Reopen: Home leaves it under way; Continue on the home reopens it as it was.

Level 2 (熟练): a box with a slope cut, seen from above in the picture, asked from below: the front corner printed at the top, the horizon under the box. Level 3 (稳): a cone on its base seen from above, asked from another height above it: only the near upright, the horizon and the small angle box printed; Compare lays the cone's outlines and its base's ellipse (the hidden half dashed) over my line; Construction shows the base's square, its diagonals and middles. I choose Again; Finish; That's all for today: the home offers it again on the side.
